name: useAgentResources
description: Read optional tool, MCP and skill metadata for a catalog Agent through the context KitClient.
notes: Passing null skips the lookup. This application query is separate from the explicit ChatProvider.

name: useUsageLimits
description: Observe local-member usage limits through the context KitClient with loading, error, data and explicit reload.
notes: Only a successful null response means the current identity is not a local member; an error must not unlock consumption.

name: createChatController
description: Own one framework-independent Session subscription, message state and execution actions.
notes: connect waits for authoritative readiness, not for the persistent stream to end.
Only the Controller schedules reconnects; writes are not automatically repeated.
The host must unsubscribe and dispose when ownership ends.
Uses the Provider message strategy or transformSessionEvent when omitted; state remains in Chat.

name: ChatController
description: Snapshot subscription, send/stop/approval actions and explicit disposal without React.

name: createSessionStore
description: Own event snapshots and Chat state, invoking an optional injected message strategy during reconstruction.
notes: Independent Store consumers own event delivery; useChat consumers configure the strategy on their Provider instead.
Omitting transformMessage uses transformSessionEvent.

name: SessionStoreOptions
description: Optional message transformation strategy for an independently managed Session Store.

name: useChat
description: Subscribe to one Session through KitProvider or an explicit stable ChatProvider.
notes: Pass null before selecting or creating a Session; this does not open a subscription.
The explicit-provider overload works without KitProvider and takes precedence over context.
Share one hook result with the message, composer, and approval UI.

name: UseChatOptions
description: Options for a Session backed by an application-owned ChatProvider.
notes: Both sessionId and provider are required; sessionId can be null.
A changed Provider identity or Session ID replaces the Controller.

name: UseChatResult
description: Message projections, connection and execution state, pending approvals, and asynchronous actions.
notes: connected reflects connection only; canSend also includes execution and Session state.
Messages and parts may be replaced by authoritative snapshots; keep their stable IDs.
turnRunning includes waiting for approval and interruption confirmation.
No public message mutation, regenerate, or request queue API is provided.

name: send
description: Wait for subscription readiness and submit one message; optionally target a newly created Session.
notes: Promise resolution means acceptance, not completion of the Agent response.
Retain the draft on failure; connection recovery does not resend the message.
Pass options.sessionId immediately after creation to avoid the previous render's selected ID.

name: stop
description: Request remote interruption and wait for the request result.
notes: A successful request does not itself confirm execution ended.
Switching Sessions and unmounting only cancel the browser subscription.

name: refreshApprovals
description: Query the current pending tool set, especially after an uncertain or stale decision.
notes: Query before another explicit user confirmation; never automatically repeat a decision POST.

name: submitApproval
description: Refresh and validate one current tool request, then submit the user's allow or deny decision.
notes: Changed arguments or invalidated state require renewed review and confirmation.
The backend independently checks ownership, current batch/call, and prior responses.

name: KitProvider
description: React context supplying a stable KitClient to default data hooks.
notes: KitProvider is distinct from ChatProvider and the server-side ProviderGateway.
An explicit ChatProvider does not redirect useSessions or useKitClient.
Host capabilities belong to the consuming application, not the SDK.

name: createKitClient
description: Create the default Kit Server client with a runtime API base URL and application identity headers.
notes: Do not assume the API shares the page origin.
Create Sessions and handle files outside useChat.

name: ChatProvider
description: Five required backend methods and an optional message transformation strategy supplied to useChat.
notes: Keep its object identity stable across renders.
Provider defines conversion; Chat invokes it against the latest event ledger and owns the messages.

name: ChatToolApproval
description: Tool request projection including pending, submitting, submitted, uncertain, or stale UI state.
notes: Only a pending actionable request may be confirmed.
Use the current batch_id and call_id as identity, not the tool name.

name: ToolApprovalDecision
description: One explicit allow or deny decision identified by current batch and call.
notes: The optional deny_message has a 200-character Kit limit.
Denying one tool call is separate from stopping the whole Session.

name: usePlaza
description: Read Kit Server discovery entries, categories, and featured/popular slug lists.
notes: Requires KitProvider; an explicit ChatProvider does not redirect this hook.
category/q changes trigger loading; reload requests a new snapshot.

name: useQuota
description: Read monthly Credits, packs, daily usage and the current pending increase request.
notes: Requires KitProvider; quota enforcement remains server-side.
The limit excludes packs; unlimited remaining is -1.

name: useQuotaRequests
description: Read the current identity's quota increase request history.
notes: Requires KitProvider.
Query failure currently clears requests to an empty array; no error field is exposed.

name: createMemberAuthController
description: Own local member sign-in, restore, revocation, expiry and one fixed-identity Client per generation.

name: MemberAuthController
description: Framework-independent member authentication lifecycle and observable snapshot.

name: MemberAuthOptions
description: Final API URL, explicit authentication mode, host storage and optional fetch implementation.

name: MemberAuthSnapshot
description: Authentication status, public member profile, isolated Client, generation, pending state and error.

name: MemberSessionStorage
description: Host storage adapter scoped to a full API URL; never store passwords.

name: StoredMemberSession
description: Opaque member access token and its fixed expiry time.

name: useMemberAuth
description: Subscribe to a stable member auth controller and bind start/dispose to the React lifecycle.

name: ChatMultiAgent
description: Native Chat thread view, independent loading and pagination actions.

name: ChatAgentThread
description: One child Agent instance, projected messages, history state and display name.

name: ChatSnapshot
description: Session state plus the native Multi-Agent view.

name: useSessionDirectory
description: Load grouped and recent sessions, retain pages and prepare explicit session confirmations.

name: useSessionSearch
description: Debounce and cancel server searches using the directory pagination contract.

name: useSessionDetails
description: Load historical file metadata and inject it into the existing Chat state.

name: useAttachments
description: Upload, scan, cancel and consume attachment staging without file-picker UI.

name: useComposer
description: Create a session and invoke existing Chat.send; failures reject and retain submitted files.

name: useArtifactActions
description: Read authenticated artifact bytes and coordinate safe preview or save through an injected host.

name: useQuotaRecovery
description: Only recover sending after a fresh server result confirms every enabled limit.

name: useCreateQuotaRequest
description: Submit one explicit credit request without automatic retries.

name: createSessionDirectory
description: Framework-independent directory state, pagination and session operations.

name: createSessionSearch
description: Framework-independent debounced search with cancellation.

name: createSessionDetails
description: Load session metadata with request generation isolation.

name: createSessionActions
description: Prepare, cancel and confirm session mutations without reusing failed confirmation tokens.

name: createAttachments
description: Framework-independent upload and scan lifecycle.

name: createComposer
description: Framework-independent session creation and send coordination; no draft state.

name: deriveTitle
description: Derive a session title from the first message.

name: createArtifactActions
description: Framework-independent artifact workflow with injected host effects.

name: resolveArtifactType
description: Resolve artifact MIME type from metadata, filename and response.

name: previewableArtifactType
description: Allow inert artifact previews and reject active content.

name: createQuotaRecovery
description: Observe fresh usage limits before allowing recovery.

name: readQuotaExceeded
description: Read validated quota details without guessing from an error message.

name: usageLimitsAllowSending
description: Require all enabled monthly and daily metrics to be confirmed available.

name: createQuery
description: Observe an explicitly refreshed query with cancellation, request-generation isolation and the last successful snapshot.
notes: Refreshing aborts the previous read; failures retain data and resolve to undefined.
Dispose cancels reading and ignores late results. The host owns subscription cleanup.

name: createMutation
description: Run one explicit write at a time and expose pending and error state.
notes: Never automatically retries or cancels a write; action errors still reject the returned Promise.
Dispose only suppresses snapshot updates; a new view should create its own controller.

name: createObservable
description: Publish host-owned snapshots to subscribers without React, networking or administration business rules.
notes: set replaces the snapshot; unsubscribe when the host releases its view.

name: QuerySnapshot
description: Query data, loading status and readable error for the current target.
